description: The Dragon Aspects - a fire caster whose biggest spells echo themselves.
_source_note: Rebuilt 5 Nov 2026 from the 40 real CoA Draconic talents (role DPS). ASPECT OF TIME MAPS ONTO bonus_pct almost perfectly - a live payload that adds a percentage of the TRIGGERING HIT's own amount, so CoA's 33% chance for 30% of the damage dealt ports exactly; only the 3-echo chain is lost, since a proc cannot re-enter its own trigger. Owns three gated abilities at tiers 4, 5 and 6, preserved in place and asserted. Heat and Embers still do not exist and this tree leans on Embers harder than Incineration did.

nodes.name: Critical Pressure
nodes.description: Increases your Intellect by 6% and your spell critical strike chance by 6%.
nodes._source: CoA over 2 ranks: 'Increases your Intellect and critical strike chance by 3%.' Doubled for the two ranks and authored as the full-investment ceiling. Both keys happen to take the same unit here - intellect_pct is percentage POINTS and crit_chance_spell is a PERCENT - which is not true of most pairs in this project.

nodes.name: Timed Attacks
nodes.description: Increases your haste by 8%.
nodes._source: CoA over 2 ranks: 'Increases your spell haste by 4%.' Doubled for the two ranks. PERCENT.

nodes.name: Alexstrasza's Gift
nodes.description: Increases the damage of Explode, Flames of Neltharion and Lava Shard by 8.1%.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Increases the damage and healing of your Ember spenders by 15%.' Embers do not exist (see the Incineration builder - Pyromancer's resource is MANA with no secondary), so 'Ember spenders' is read as the three big direct nukes Frontier has. The healing half is dropped: none of those three heal, so ability_*_healing on them would be dead data.

nodes.name: Searing Flames
nodes.description: Increases the damage of Lava Shard by 16.2%.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Increases the spell bonus scaling of Lava Shard by 30%.' There is no key for how much an ability scales with spell power - the coefficients live on the ability - so it is expressed as damage.

nodes.name: Agonizing Burns
nodes.description: Increases the duration of Blaze by 1 turn.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Increases the duration of Blaze by 20% and allows it to benefit from your spell haste.' The second half is a non-issue: haste already applies to everything here, so there is nothing to switch on - the same shape as Venomancer Vizier's 'can no longer miss'. 20% of Blaze's duration rounds to a turn. The small integer keeps this node out of the rank policy's reach.

nodes.name: Aspect of Time
nodes.description: Echo of Nozdormu and Flames of Neltharion have a 33% chance to echo, striking again for 30% of the damage dealt.
nodes._source: CoA's level 20 passive, verbatim: 'Damage dealt by Echo of Nozdormu and Flames of Neltharion now has a 33% chance to cast an additional time for 30% of the damage dealt. Damage dealt in this way can trigger this effect up to 3 additional times.' THIS IS THE CLEANEST TRANSLATION IN THE TREE. bonus_pct is a live payload that adds a percentage of the TRIGGERING HIT's own amount to that same hit (status_effects.py:1360) - it actually reads the damage dealt, which almost nothing else in this engine does, so CoA's 33% and 30% are both exact. WHAT IS LOST IS THE CHAIN: a proc's payload cannot re-enter its own trigger, so the echo happens once rather than cascading up to four times.

nodes.name: Aspect's Blessing
nodes.description: Increases the critical strike chance of Echo of Nozdormu and Flames of Neltharion by 25%.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Your next Echo of Nozdormu or Flames of Neltharion is guaranteed to critically strike and triggers Aspect of Time, casting an additional time for 30% of the damage dealt. Lasts 15 sec.' A GUARANTEED CRIT HAS NO KEY - crit at 100 would be a permanent stat, not a one-shot - and nothing empowers a named next cast. Frontier HAS Aspect's Blessing as an ability, so this is not its unlock; the talent is built as flat crit on exactly CoA's two abilities, priced at 25% rather than 100% because it applies always. CoA's Flames of Fate node, which trades Aspect's Blessing cooldown for extra casts, needs the same charge counter and is not built.

nodes.name: Cinderstorm
nodes.description: Increases the critical strike chance of Firefall by 10% and reduces the threat it generates by 25%.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Reduces all threat generated by Firefall by -25% and increases its critical strike chance by 10%.' Both halves live, though the threat reduction cannot be scoped to one ability - threat_generation_pct is a character-wide FRACTION where NEGATIVE reduces - so it applies to everything. Broader than CoA's, stated rather than hidden.

nodes.name: Overwhelming Flames
nodes.description: Lava Shard splashes 50% of its damage onto 1 nearby enemy.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Your Lava Shard now spreads Blaze to up to 1 additional enemy within 8 yds of the primary target.' SPREADING A DOT TO A NEW TARGET IS NOT A PAYLOAD - apply_effect lands on the trigger's own target - so it becomes splash_damage at CoA's one extra enemy, the same translation as the Witch Doctor's Malignant and Venomancer Vizier's Sage.

nodes.name: Soul of the Dragon
nodes.description: Flare Bolt has a 15% chance to cast again for free.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Casting Flare Bolt now has a 15% chance to cast it again free of cost.' PORTS EXACTLY - cast_ability takes a bare ability id, Flare Bolt is auto-learned so it is in the book, and a payload-cast does not charge the resource, which is what 'free of cost' means. CoA's 15% kept, with a 1-turn internal cooldown so the recast cannot chain into itself.

nodes.name: Mad Aspect's Scepter
nodes.description: Increases the damage of Destroyer's Maw by 21.6%.
nodes._source: CoA over 2 ranks: 'Increases the damage of Destroyer's Maw by 20%.' Doubled for the two ranks. Destroyer's Maw exists in Frontier; CoA's version deals damage 'that cannot be resisted', which has no key - resistance is applied in take_damage with no per-ability bypass - so that rider is dropped.

nodes.name: Flames of the Aspects
nodes.description: Destroyer's Maw sets you flamecasting, raising your haste by 10% for 5 turns.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Casting Destroyer's Maw now grants 2 stacks of Flamecasting. Increases your spell haste by 5% for 15 seconds. Stacks 5 times.' A PAYLOAD CANNOT GRANT TWO STACKS AT ONCE, so one cast gives one stack; the description states the 10% two stacks would reach, since Destroyer's Maw is cast often enough to hold two. Shares the effect_id with Incineration's Wreath of Flames deliberately - it is the same Flamecasting buff in CoA, so a Pyromancer with both does not carry two separate stacks of it. 15 sec is 5 turns.

nodes.name: Lifebringer's Blessing
nodes.description: Echo of Nozdormu and Flames of Neltharion heal you for 20% of the damage they deal.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Damage dealt by Aspect of Time now heals you equal to 200% of the damage dealt.' Aspect of Time's echo is a bonus_pct rider rather than a separate damage event, so there is nothing to hang a second proc off - this fires off the same two abilities instead. leech_pct reads the triggering hit's amount, so the scaling IS real here. Priced at 20% rather than CoA's 200%: that figure is against the echo's 30% share, and 200% of a full nuke would make the spec unkillable.

nodes.name: Draconic Tempest
nodes.description: Dragon's Wrath melts the enemy, leaving them taking 5% more spell damage for 3 turns.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Your Dragon's Wrath now melts enemies, increasing their chance to be hit by spells by 3% for 10 sec.' THERE IS NO RECIPIENT-SIDE 'CHANCE TO BE HIT' KEY - hit lives on the attacker - so it becomes spell damage taken, raised to 5% since it replaces a hit bonus with a damage bonus. 10 sec is 3 turns.

nodes.name: Flames of Execution
nodes.description: Increases the damage of Blaze by 13.5%.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Damage dealt by Blaze is increased by 25% on enemies below 35% of their maximum health.' NO EFFECT KEY READS A TARGET'S HEALTH PERCENTAGE - high_health_damage_threshold_pct is dead, and the working low_health pair on Venomancer Fortitude is about the CARRIER's own health, not a target's - so the condition is dropped and CoA's 25% applies always.

nodes.name: Perpetual Burning
nodes.description: Increases the duration of Blaze by a further 1 turn and the damage your damage-over-time spells deal by 15%.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'The duration of Blaze is now increased by 1 sec for each Ember you have when you cast it.' Embers do not exist and nothing reads a live resource amount, so the per-Ember scaling cannot be built. Granted as a flat turn, stacking with Agonizing Burns at tier 0, plus dot damage to carry the node. Small integer, so outside the rank policy.

nodes.name: Molten Fury
nodes.description: Increases the damage of Eruption by 15% and reduces its cooldown by 40%.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Increases the damage and healing provided by Eruption by 15%, but reduces its duration by 50%.' The 15% ports. The duration downside is NOT built - no key reduces an ability's duration, only increases it - so this node is strictly stronger than CoA's, stated rather than hidden. CoA's Blackrock Mountaineer ('reduces the cooldown of Eruption by -30 sec') is folded in as the 40%, since two nodes for one ability's cooldown would be padding.

nodes.name: Expediting Power
nodes.description: Echo of Nozdormu brings Aspect's Blessing two turns closer to ready.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Your Echo of Nozdormu now reduces the cooldown of Aspect's Blessing by an additional 5%.' A percentage of a remaining cooldown is not expressible - reset_cooldown takes whole turns or a full reset - so 5% of a 1-minute cooldown becomes 2 turns, with a 1-turn icd so it cannot stack within a turn. Both abilities exist in Frontier.

nodes.name: Echo of Nozdormu
nodes.description: Teaches Echo of Nozdormu, a chromatic nuke that shortens your cooldowns.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Transforms your Explode into Echo of Nozdormu. Obliterate an enemy, dealing Chromatic Damage and reducing all spell and ability cooldowns by 5%.' LOAD-BEARING UNLOCK: pyromancer_echo_of_nozdormu carries requires_talent, so without this node it is unobtainable forever - and five other nodes in this tree name it. Nothing transforms one ability into another, so it is granted alongside Explode rather than replacing it. Kept at tier 4 exactly where the shipped tree had it, preserving Pyromancer's 4/5/6 pattern.

nodes.name: Draconic Invocation
nodes.description: Increases all damage you deal by 3.9%.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Invoke all of the Dragon Aspects, instantly generating 5 Embers.' EMBERS DO NOT EXIST - there is no secondary resource to generate - so the entire ability is inert as a concept here. Frontier HAS Draconic Invocation as an ability and it is NOT gated, so this node cannot be its unlock either. Rebuilt as flat damage, which is what five Embers would have been spent on. NOT a faithful copy and flagged as such.

nodes.name: Fire and Brimstone
nodes.description: Your nukes stoke the fire, raising your damage by 1% per stack for 3 turns, stacking 5 times.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Generating an Ember now increases the damage and healing of Ember spenders by 1% for 10 sec, stacking 5 times.' There is no Ember to generate, so the trigger is re-pointed at casting the spenders themselves - which in CoA is what consumed them, so the stacks build in the same part of the rotation. CoA's 1% and 5 stacks kept; 10 sec is 3 turns. damage_dealt_pct inside a status effect is percentage POINTS.

nodes.name: Ascender
nodes.description: Reduces the cooldown of Dragon Leap by 30%.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Reduces the cooldown of Dragon Leap by -5 sec.' Expressed as a percentage against the ability's own cooldown. POSITIVE reduces, so CoA's minus sign is dropped.

nodes.name: Inner Flame
nodes.description: Teaches Inner Flame, a party-wide draconic blessing.
nodes._source: LOAD-BEARING UNLOCK: pyromancer_inner_flame carries requires_talent, so without this node it is unobtainable forever. It is also target_type 'party', so it genuinely reaches every living ally - one of only six party-targeted Pyromancer abilities. Kept at tier 5 where the shipped tree had it.

nodes.name: Earthwarder
nodes.description: Taking a hit has a 20% chance to make your next Flare Bolt strike for fire damage.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Being struck by a melee attack while Draconic Aspect is active now has a 20% chance to make your next Flare Bolt within 8 seconds instant cast.' Three walls: no 'while buff active' gate, no trigger-side melee filter, and no cast times to make instant. Rebuilt as retaliation damage on being hit, keeping CoA's 20%, with a 2-turn internal cooldown so a heavy incoming turn does not fire it repeatedly.

nodes.name: Draconic Aspect
nodes.description: Increases your spell damage by 15%.
nodes._source: CoA's own description for this node is the unresolved token '$8e' - the Builder payload never expands it - so there is no verbatim text and this is NOT a faithful copy. Frontier HAS Draconic Aspect as an ability and it is not gated, so this cannot be its unlock. Named from CoA's own title and built as flat spell damage. Flagged so a later pass can correct it, the same situation as Incineration's Magmatic ('$8a').

nodes.name: Death From Above
nodes.description: Teaches Death From Above, and Echo of Nozdormu and Flames of Neltharion hit 18.9% harder.
nodes._source: LOAD-BEARING UNLOCK: pyromancer_death_from_above carries requires_talent, so without this node it is unobtainable forever. Kept at tier 6, completing Pyromancer's 4/5/6 gated-ability pattern across all three trees. The damage on the two Aspect nukes is added because a capstone that only grants an ability is thin, and it pays off Aspect of Time at tier 1 - the bigger the nuke, the bigger its echo, since bonus_pct is a share of the hit. Same shape as Incineration's Pyroclasm capstone.

nodes.name: Draconic Fury
nodes.description: Increases the critical strike damage of your spells by 20% per rank.
nodes._source: Authored 6 Nov. Kyle: 'all caster classes should have a 5 point talent that increases their spell crit damage by 100%.' Mirrors priest_shadow's Shadow Power and shaman_elemental's Elemental Fury, both of which are WoW-accurate at 5 x 20%. Placed on tier 4 beside the existing tier-4 block; connected_to is cosmetic (it draws the edge), spending is gated by tier_requirements.
